name: badge
description: A small status pill / label: a styled span with themed variants (default, secondary, outline, destructive). Decorative by default — the text carries the meaning, with guidance to label colour-only status for assistive tech.

notes: Renders inline text, so its label is read in place — no role needed
When status is signalled by colour alone, the text or an aria-label must still convey it (never colour-only)

intents: a status pill / badge / chip / tag label
a small coloured label for state (new, draft, failed, beta)
